text: ST.O.A1.3 — Coalition value by marginal contribution (M26) [can_we_win-c14], [negot-c06]. Shapley value: in a transferable-utility cooperative game, it is the unique allocation satisfying efficiency, symmetry, null player and additivity (Shapley 1953; uses MA.B.C4 (91A)). Veto players [advanced-c14]. Triangular diplomacy [kissinger-c08]. Calculated betrayal and exit [can_we_win-c03], [can_we_win-c15], [can_we_win-c20]. Alliance entrapment and abandonment (no card yet). Minimum-winning coalitions as a claim about cabinets are PO.O.A2; ST.O.A1.3 uses PO.O.A2.

warrant.standard: The coalition result holds under the stated value function; cases show the predicted split.
warrant.defeaters: Utility not transferable; trust and identity outside the model.
